description.en: The Dracula palette: a deep purple-grey night with pink and purple highlights, a gradient button and a cyan link color. CSS only, so organization admins can install it.
Focused fields, the selected tab and the start of the button gradient, which ends in Dracula pink.

theme.json.formCss:
<style>
.login-background {
  color-scheme: dark;
  --background: 231 15% 18%;
  --foreground: 60 30% 96%;
  --card: 232 14% 24%;
  --card-foreground: 60 30% 96%;
  --popover: 232 14% 24%;
  --popover-foreground: 60 30% 96%;
  --muted: 232 14% 31%;
  --muted-foreground: 225 27% 70%;
  --accent: 232 14% 31%;
  --accent-foreground: 60 30% 96%;
  --border: 232 14% 34%;
  --input: 232 14% 34%;
  --ring: 60 30% 96%;
  font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', sans-serif;
  background: radial-gradient(ellipse 55% 45% at 85% 10%, rgba(255, 121, 198, 0.16) 0%, transparent 70%), radial-gradient(ellipse 55% 45% at 10% 95%, rgba(189, 147, 249, 0.16) 0%, transparent 70%), #282a36;
}


.login-content > div {
  max-width: 420px;
}
.login-panel {
  border: 1px solid #44475a;
  border-radius: 14px;
  background: #21222c;
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(189, 147, 249, 0.12), 0 30px 70px -20px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7);
}
.login-background > div:first-of-type button {
  color: #9aa5ce;
}
.signin-methods > div {
  border: 1px solid #44475a;
  background: #282a36;
}
.signin-methods [role='tab'] {
  color: #9aa5ce;
}
.signin-methods [role='tab'][data-state='active'] {
  background: #44475a !important;
  color: {{accentColor}};
  box-shadow: none !important;
}
.login-form label {
  color: #f8f8f2;
  font-weight: 500;
}
.login-form input:not([type='checkbox']):not([type='radio']) {
  height: 44px;
  border: 1px solid #44475a;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: #282a36;
  color: #f8f8f2;
  box-shadow: none;
}
.login-form input:not([type='checkbox']):not([type='radio'])::placeholder {
  color: #9aa5ce;
}
.login-form input:not([type='checkbox']):not([type='radio']):focus {
  border-color: {{accentColor}};
  box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, {{accentColor}} 25%, transparent);
}
.login-password button {
  color: #9aa5ce;
}
.login-form [role='checkbox'] {
  border-color: #9aa5ce;
  border-radius: 4px;
}
.login-form [role='checkbox'][data-state='checked'] {
  background: {{accentColor}};
  border-color: {{accentColor}};
  color: #282a36;
}
.login-form a {
  color: #8be9fd;
  font-weight: 500;
}
.login-form .login-button {
  height: 44px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, {{accentColor}} 0%, #ff79c6 100%);
  color: #282a36;
  font-weight: 600;
  box-shadow: none;
}
.login-form .login-button:hover {
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, {{accentColor}} 0%, #ff79c6 100%);
  filter: brightness(1.08);
}
.login-form .login-signup-link,
.login-form .login-forget-password label {
  color: #f8f8f2;
}
#footer {
  color: #9aa5ce;
}
.login-form .login-forget-password {
  width: 100%;
}
</style>
